summary: GigaMedia filed a 6-K furnishing its notice of annual general meeting and proxy statement for its 27th AGM to be held on June 25, 2026. The agenda includes routine items: adoption of audited 2025 financial statements, reappointment of Deloitte Touche as auditors, approval of director remuneration up to $350,000, authority to allot shares under Singapore's Companies Act, and a share purchase mandate. There are no special-situation elements such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or management change; the filing is a standard foreign private issuer report of a shareholder meeting.
